target.topic_name: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
target.source_page: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building

card.fact_statement: The Ministry of Labour announced it would provide compensation for relatives of those who died in the collapse.
card.source_span: The Ministry of Labour announced that it would provide up to two million baht in compensation for relatives of each those who died
aliases: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building

target_qa_variants.question: Ni idara gani ya serikali iliyotangaza kuwa itatoa fidia kwa ndugu wa wale waliofariki katika kuporomoka kwa jengo la Ofisi ya Ukaguzi wa Serikali ya Thailand?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The Ministry of Labour announced that it would provide up to two million baht in compensation for relatives of each those who died
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'government department' to 'idara ya serikali' and 'Ministry of Labour' to 'Wizara ya Kazi'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which government department announced that it will provide compensation to the relatives of those who died in the collapse of the building of the Government Audit Office of Thailand?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Swahili translation accurately preserves the meaning, entities, and expected answer of the source English QA.
